svg.title: Counties with more physical inactivity tend to have higher diabetes estimates
svg.desc: Scatter plot of 2,956 U.S. counties using 2023 age-adjusted CDC PLACES estimates. Each point is a county. A smoothed trend curve summarizes a strong positive association; it is not causal.
svg.text: More physical inactivity, higher diabetes estimates
Each point is one county; the smoothed trend line summarizes the pattern without implying causation.
